content.text: Enter Gower, before the monument of Marina at Tarsus.

lines.text: Thus time we waste, and long leagues make short;
lines.plainText: Thus time we waste and long leagues make short

lines.text: Sail seas in cockles, have and wish but for't;
lines.plainText: Sail seas in cockles have and wish but for't

lines.text: Making, to take your imagination,
lines.plainText: Making to take your imagination

lines.text: From bourn to bourn, region to region.
lines.plainText: From bourn to bourn region to region

lines.text: By you being pardon'd, we commit no crime
lines.plainText: By you being pardon'd we commit no crime

lines.text: To use one language in each several clime
lines.plainText: To use one language in each several clime

lines.text: Where our scenes seem to live. I do beseech you
lines.plainText: Where our scenes seem to live I do beseech you

lines.text: Attended on by many a lord and knight,

lines.text: This king to Tarsus,—think his pilot thought;

lines.text: So with his steerage shall your thoughts go on,—

lines.text: To fetch his daughter home, who first is gone.
lines.plainText: To fetch his daughter home who first is gone

content.text: Dumb-show. Enter Pericles at one door with all his train; Cleon and Dionyza at the other. Cleon shows Pericles the tomb; whereat Pericles makes lamentation, puts on sackcloth and in a mighty passion departs. Then exeunt Cleon and Dionyza.
